Maria: Huge thanks to @June and @Rahul — they swooped in during the demo and fixed the env var mixup in like 10 mins. Saved the customer call. :sparkles:
June: ahaha team effort! no big, just swapped the unmasked token and restarted the canary. :thumbsup:
Rahul: Was that the 'REDWOOD_API_KEY' nod? :eyes: Also added a quick log filter so the dashboard stopped choking. We should add a sanity check in the deploy pipeline.
Sam: <3 amazing. Pizza on me for the on-call heroes? Poll: :pizza: or :donut:?
Leah: :raised_hands: pizza. Also added a 1-line blurb to the runbook about env var naming to avoid future facepalms.
OpsBot: Note created: "env-var-naming" added to #runbook by @Leah (auto-saved).
June: Vote recorded for pizza. Also big props to Rahul for the calm rollback plan — so clean. :clap:
Maria: Officially logging this into the gratitude thread — adding a tiny token to your kudos buckets, Rahul + June. :star2: Thanks everyone for being quick on the taps!
